title: Inhibition of mTOR blocks the anti-inflammatory effects of glucocorticoids in myeloid immune cells - ScienceDirect
abstract:

Although glucocorticoids (GCs) exert potent anti-inflammatory effects in innate immune cells, it is currently unknown whether the mTOR pathway interferes with GC signaling. Here we show that inhibition of mTOR with rapamycin or Torin1 prevented the anti-inflammatory potency of GC both in human monocytes and myeloid dendritic cells.
